about: The stimulus deck: things from outside web design and outside any one category. roll.mjs --stimulus deals two before the seven worlds are written, and worlds 6 and 7 must each fuse one dealt stimulus with an item of the subject's inventory. A stimulus is a provocation, never a theme: what does this subject look like if it behaves like a seed packet? Families keep the deck from clustering in paper and print.

stimuli.name: a seed packet: a picture of the promise, sowing instructions on the back
a herbarium sheet: one pressed specimen, a label, a collector's hand
an allotment plan: plots, rotations, a shed and a water butt
a beekeeper's frame lifted out of the hive, cells capped and open
a tide table: two highs and two lows a day, a coefficient
a weather fax: isobars, fronts, a timestamp and noise
a barometer: one needle, a fixed hand set by its owner, words for weather
a snow gauge on a pole: depth read by eye against painted bands
a split-flap departure board: letters clattering into place
a luggage tag: a three-letter code, a barcode, a torn stub
a tram route map: coloured lines, interchange rings, a terminus
a ferry ticket: a crossing time, a deck, a car or foot passenger
a darts scoreboard: chalk subtraction from 501 down to a checkout
a pinball playfield: ramps, lit targets, a score that only goes up
a climbing topo: a line drawn on a photo of rock, a grade, bolts
a bingo card: numbers daubed one by one until a line is full
ice-rink markings seen from above after the resurfacer has passed
an enamel street sign: a district number, a border, chips in the glaze
a parking meter: coins in, minutes out, a red flag at zero
a vending machine: a grid of codes, a spiral that turns, a drop
a punch card: holes in columns, a corner cut to show which way up
a lift floor indicator: an arrow, a number, a bell at arrival
a fire escape plan: you are here, arrows, the nearest exit
a hymn board: numbers slotted into a wooden frame for today
a tile pattern book: one repeat, its colourways, how it meets the edge
a quarry core sample: years as bands of stone, laid in a box
stained glass: colour held by lead lines, light passing through
a lighthouse lens: rings of glass, one beam, a characteristic flash
an aquarium: one glass front, layers of water, a label per species
a laundry care label: five symbols, a fibre count, a country
a sewing pattern on tissue: overlapping sizes, notches, grain lines
a knitting chart: one square per stitch, a row counter
a recipe card with stains: quantities, a crossed-out step, a note
a butcher's cut chart: one animal divided into named parts
a bread bag clip: the day it was baked, coded in a colour
a till receipt: items, a total, the time to the second, a long tail
a library due-date card: stamped dates from strangers going back years
a sheet of stamps: one design, perforations, a margin with plate numbers
a crossword grid: black squares, numbered starts, clues across and down
a cassette j-card: a spine, a track list in a hand, side A and side B
a metronome: a weight on a pendulum, a tempo marking, a click
an eye chart: letters shrinking line by line until you stop reading
a seismograph drum: a needle tracing calm until something happens
a litmus strip held against its colour scale
